1.consolidated_definition: Pequeño sofá en el que dos personas se pueden sentar próximas. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Vendo dos love seat en rattan. Buenas condiciones. Tengo tela para tapizar en color neutral de tener interes por $20. adicionales (MundoAnuncio, PR, 19-08-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Small sofa for two people to sit close together. Raw Anglicism, commonly used. Selling two love seats made of rattan in good condition. I have neutral-colored fabric available for upholstery at an additional $20 (MundoAnuncio, PR, 19-08-07)
